authority: User requested a concrete A-F falsification rubric; root chooses this editorial policy within that authorized scope. No additional user approval is implied.
purpose: Report the informativeness and predictive losses of one dated forecast on the declared event and complete cohort. A letter does not establish long-run calibration.

dimensions.winner: Mean Brier/2 on a fixed exhaustive target, compared with matched basic-history probabilities. Senate principal-pair relative lead and House D/R/O party winner remain separate targets.
dimensions.interval: Mean proper central90 interval score on eligible named-pair margins, compared with matched basic-history intervals. Label90% interval skill, not full-CDF skill.
dimensions.point: Show named mean margin errors/MAE descriptively; not a separate grade component.

skill: 1 - model_mean_loss / matched_history_mean_loss, only for positive baseline loss; preserve raw paired loss differences.
bandsQualification: Editorial cutoffs, not statistically or scientifically universal constants. Use unrounded losses for assignment; numerical equality tolerance must be declared by implementation.
overall: Lower of winner and90% interval grades. Unsupported pair targets retain their predeclared separate cohort and unavailable counts; never invent margins. An overall two-component letter is unavailable if no margin cohort exists; a clearly labeled winner-only grade may be reported.

coinFlipCap.rule: No better than D overall if winner skill against fixed D/R coin-flip reference is nonpositive. A naturally lower F remains F. This editorial information gate is separate from the proper scoring rule.
coinFlipCap.senate: (.5,.5) on the exact two named principal relative-lead event.
coinFlipCap.house: (.5,.5,0) on the same exhaustive D/R/O party-winner event and all locked races. Never conditionally drop Other winners.
coinFlipCap.houseUniformReference: Also show (1/3,1/3,1/3) losses, labeled uniform-three-category. It is not the D/R-discrimination gate.
coinFlipCap.scope: Probabilities and supported outcomes are not altered to earn a letter. Honest uncertainty remains visible in raw scores even if the editorial informativeness grade is low.

houseEvent.completion: Preserve native D/R/O probability mass; explicitly fill absent groups with0 for evaluation, distinguish structural absence from finite-draw zero.
houseEvent.outsideGroupWinner: Retain in full cohort; ordinary finite Brier and explicit infinite log loss at locked p0. No smoothing, exclusion or renormalization.
houseEvent.outsideCandidateWinner: Keep separate omitted-candidate-ID diagnostic; correct party prediction does not establish a correct named-candidate prediction.

coverage.finalLetter: Require final or certified matched results for every locked target in each graded cohort; preserve all pending/unresolved/unsupported rows. No silent result-dependent subset.
coverage.partial: Show descriptive partial scoreboard, n/N and raw losses for the same available matched rows, with clear incomplete-status labels; no extrapolated complete-cohort letter.
coverage.delay: Use the predeclared official/source escalation and revision policy. Do not fabricate finality to make the grade appear.
coverage.futureOption: A conservative all-admissible-completions grade bound may be added as a separate pre-outcome version after implementation review; not part of V1.

baselineZero: If matched-history mean loss is0, percentage skill is undefined. Show raw differences and no inferred component letter until a predeclared reviewed alternative rule exists.
jointChecks: Show native shared-election error/miss/coverage reference diagnostics separately; do not grade the model from its own nominal coverage or use joint-tail surprise as an automatic failure.
unfinished: Exact final evaluation edition/horizon/cohort/result mapping and immutable lock
